definition.en: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time, leading to a decline in the purchasing power of money.
definition.hi: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services in an economy over a period of time, leading to a decline in the purchasing power of money.

importanceInUpsc.en: Inflation is a critical component of the UPSC GS-3 syllabus, as it directly impacts macroeconomic stability and the standard of living. Understanding its dynamics is essential for analyzing monetary policy decisions by the RBI and fiscal measures taken by the government.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the fundamental mechanics of price level changes in the Indian economy.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of institutional frameworks in managing price stability.
